completion_text: The Conservator's harness falls silent. You release its claim on the apparatus. The two altered regions remain, but no further uncontrolled resonance follows.
boss_preview: The Conservator: sidestep White, leave the Blue-held Red mark, read Green's two branches. Emergency releases interrupt a channel and expose the harness.

records.title: A human inside the apparatus
records.text: The Conservator once collected survivors. Now the operator wears the same restraints: ordinary hands and a human face divided by branching mineral scars. White imposes an impulse; Green branches its direction. Neither mark follows after commitment. Step sideways from a single lane, or read the gap between two.

records.title: The emergency releases
records.text: Two grounded pedestals drain the active harness channel. Reach either one and use it during a warning to cancel the whole sequence and expose the operator. The releases then cool. Ordinary movement, cover and your own interrupts also work. Blue holds your marked position before Red warns and releases there; leave that ground.

records.title: The final return circuit
records.text: The human harness is the last claim on these controls. Its defeat will release that claim, not send a third failsafe into your home country. Retained Fen and Excited Uplands cannot be undone here. The operator's last instruction reads: If the world will not keep them, I will remake them until it does.

design_purpose.boss: 600 life makes several sequences relevant; 14 physical and 20 fire raw damage punish missed tells using ordinary native mitigation. Periods describe the round oracle; spatial warnings and recovery own the live cadence.
design_purpose.specimens: One familiar host replaces an ordinary enemy per teaching branch; the final chamber contains only the dedicated human so no unrelated kit masks its lesson.
design_purpose.apparatus_size_m: Existing solid teaching cabinets retain their footprint and cover.
design_purpose.apparatus_offset_m: Keep early cabinets in the established outer alcoves.
design_purpose.record_spacing_m: Six metres between optional records gives individual walking and E approaches.
design_purpose.conservator_move_speed_mps: Close distance between sequences while giving ordinary movement room to escape.
design_purpose.conservator_engage_range_m: The harness begins a sequence only within its readable twelve-metre reach.
design_purpose.conservator_white_warning_seconds: Time to sidestep the committed single lane.
design_purpose.conservator_blue_hold_seconds: First distinct phase holding the target's original position.
design_purpose.conservator_red_warning_seconds: Second distinct warning before releasing at the unchanged mark.
design_purpose.conservator_green_warning_seconds: Time to recognise two copied directions and their safe gap.
design_purpose.conservator_lane_length_m: Maximum reach of both White and Green impulse lanes.
design_purpose.conservator_lane_width_m: Full visible and damaging lane width; sidestepping clears it.
design_purpose.conservator_branch_angle_degrees: Each Green branch diverges by this angle from the committed aim, leaving a readable centre gap.
design_purpose.conservator_mark_radius_m: Visible and damaging radius of the retained Red release.
design_purpose.conservator_recovery_seconds: Stationary unguarded attack opportunity after each release or ordinary interrupt.
design_purpose.conservator_release_recovery_seconds: Longer attack opportunity earned by reaching an emergency release during a channel.
design_purpose.conservator_release_cooldown_seconds: Both emergency pedestals cool together after a successful drain, preventing alternating drain spam.
design_purpose.conservator_release_side_m: Place the two solid controls on opposite sides of the final chamber.
design_purpose.conservator_release_forward_m: Move controls toward the entry side while keeping the central fight and reward path clear.
design_purpose.conservator_opening_seconds: A short visible opening lets the player read the human before the first channel.
